subject: Preserve exact campaign-description identity in mission-team natives
description: Schema-12 representative `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_linux3/Profile_003/Savegame_031/replay-007-session-0001.jsonl.zst` formerly first diverged after frame 4401 when Rust queued PC119 from `(1703.2542,335.2816)` to `(1376,486)` and exposed `MoveWaiting` / animation 2 while Original retained `Wait` / animation 0 with no path event. Sherwood's decompiled `StartUp::CheckDeploymentZone` issues that move only when the deployment-zone occupant count exceeds the mission-team size. Rust had four occupants but only three team members because PC107's deployment-zone exit after frame 4389 removed PC119's team slot: PC107 and PC119 have distinct campaign-description indices 11 and 32 but share character profile 8, and the old natives resolved both through `get_character_by_profile` to the first matching description. Original `RHScript::AddPCToMissionTeam` and `RemovePCFromMissionTeam` pass the live PC's exact `GetDescription()` pointer (`original-code/RHScript.cpp:7071-7120`), and `RHCampaign` adds/removes that pointer by identity (`original-code/RHCampaign.cpp:2061-2125`). Commit `ce8825fd0ca388886a17fe0f0e5464b7759c8a6a` therefore uses the live PC's validated `campaign_description_index`, rejects missing, out-of-range, or profile-inconsistent live identities without mutation, and retains the profile fallback only for the no-live-entity Sherwood HUD path. The focused `mission_team_natives_` set passes 3/3, covering duplicate-profile add/remove identity, corrupt live identity, and the absent-entity fallback. Authoritative optimized runner `/home/phire/robinhood/target/parity/examples/original_parity_replay` was built from base HEAD `7629b33dd` plus coordinated frozen diff `71674c038b6e`, with SHA-256 `b19a04b6e907901ccfb3cc76d8b3f42b7b6b75538b957d42c0a5450c2762c7d5`, size 65,900,101 bytes, and mtime `2026-08-11 20:11:50 +0200`. It matches all 1,500 recorded frames through exact EOF with exit status 0 for the representative (1,185 RNG draws) and same-save control `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_linux3/Profile_003/Savegame_031/replay-006-session-0001.jsonl.zst` (1,228 RNG draws). Formatting, scoped diff checks, independent source/replay review, final matrix review, and commit-scope checks pass; the committed scope is exactly `crates/robin_engine/src/natives/dispatch/campaign.rs` and `crates/robin_engine/src/natives/tests.rs`.
